Fantasy sports platform (Dream Sports), Mumbai. Tiger and TPG led the $225M round of September 2020 at about $2.5B (Financial Express, 2020-09-14), the firm's first round after reported talks in January 2020: a Growth entry. Later rounds: $400M at nearly $5B (March 2021) and $840M at $8B (November 2021, Entrackr and VCCircle headlines).
